name: MUIRBENCH
intro: MuirBench 是鲁棒多图理解基准，覆盖 12 类任务、10 类图像关系、11,264 张图像和 2,600 道多项选择题。它将 1,300 个可答样本与经过最小语义改动的 1,300 个不可答对应样本配对，用总体、任务、关系、位置和变换类型准确率诊断模型。
org: USC, UPenn, UMN, UC Davis, UW-Madison, UCLA, OSU, Microsoft Research
build_method: 现有/派生/新建数据混合构建与四专家审核
metric: 准确率（完整集合分母 2,600；官方仓库未发布完整运行器）
openness: 数据公开（CC BY 4.0，源图权利各异）；代码仓库未声明许可证
task_type: 多项选择题, 图像问答
eval_feature: 可答/不可答配对, 多图鲁棒性, 任务与关系子集
openness_en: Public data (CC BY 4.0; source-image rights vary); code repository has no license file
build_method_en: Hybrid existing/derived/new curation with four-expert review
eval_feature_en: Answerable/unanswerable pairs, multi-image robustness, task and relation subsets
intro_en: MuirBench evaluates robust multi-image understanding across 12 tasks, 10 image-relation categories, 11,264 images, and 2,600 multiple-choice questions. It pairs 1,300 answerable items with 1,300 minimally changed unanswerable counterparts and diagnoses models by overall, task, relation, position, and transform-type accuracy.

drawio_review_note: Primary-source review passed on 2026-07-21. The paper is pinned to arXiv:2406.09411v2 (last revised 2024-07-02; https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.09411v2; PDF SHA-256 e1f166ca3e2bee85d11d2cf370620d61afcd9210b65f3d318107cbe1fb619abe). Official code is pinned to https://github.com/muirbench/MuirBench/tree/840b85fe960ab6160cd566fe8360bfa80f9164db; eval/utils/preprocess.py has SHA-256 1622e21d131560e5bb729ba715b23943edb5f875a68252a005f3e7a9997a527e and postprocess.py has SHA-256 9c812f3745ef92f92470d5c47cdc96266506e162436bf0a20a6849ddc82e6b58. Official data is pinned to https://huggingface.co/datasets/MUIRBENCH/MUIRBENCH/tree/4c393cffc985c77d28de3b9045e2e5186920df80. Paper Sections 3.1-3.2 and 4.1 plus Appendices A-C support 12 tasks, 10 relation categories, 2-9 ordered images, and 1,300 answerable items: 531 existing (40.8%) from GeneCIS, SeedBench and IconQA; 282 derived (21.7%) from NLVR2, HallusionBench, ISVQA and MMBench; and 487 new (37.5%) from HistoricalMap, UnivBuilding, PubMedMQA and SciSlides. Every answerable item receives one minimal-change unanswerable counterpart: 315 image replacements/reorderings (24.2%), 459 question changes (35.3%), or 526 option changes (40.5%). Relation metadata is manual, task/type labels are aligned or filled, count/position labels are automatic, predefined checks cover format, gold answers, metadata, coreference, redundant images and accessibility, and four experts review every instance; 86.3% are retained. The final release has 2,600 MCQs, 11,264 images and mean 4.3 images. The pinned Hugging Face schema is idx, task, image_relation, image_type, question, options, answer, image_list and counterpart_idx; options range from three to five, and the release field image_list differs from the paper appendix name images. Evaluation follows VLMEvalKit with temperature 0 and retry 10; ordered images are concatenated for single-image models. preprocess.py emits dynamic A-through-E choices when five options exist, while its hint still names only A-D, followed by Answer:. postprocess.py searches parenthesized labels, bare labels, and then option text only when the response exceeds five tokens; no candidate falls back to random.choice with random.seed(42). Appendix C.2 says multiple candidates use the first occurrence, but released postprocess.py uses rfind plus argmax and therefore selects the last occurrence; the diagram exposes this paper-code drift and follows the executable code path for scoring. The official repository publishes preprocessing and parsing utilities but no full model runner or aggregation implementation, so missing-prediction behavior and incomplete denominators are not invented; full-benchmark accuracy requires all 2,600 rows. Reports preserve answerable/unanswerable, task, relation, image-position and transform-type subsets. The human protocol uses two domain experts and assigns pair members to different experts; the paper reports 93.15% overall. The data snapshot declares CC BY 4.0, while underlying source-image rights vary; the official code repository has no root LICENSE file. EN/ZH specs have identical node IDs, types, positions, and edges. Formal publication evidence [site-a11q-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 4106×1241 (English) and 4101×1241 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 4104×1239 and 4099×1239. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
